scope: Complete uniform positive ddc-preserving smoothing of continuous pluriharmonic forms on compact Kahler manifolds, with the closed-form branch.
mathematical_boundary: Retained classical Hodge heat construction and identities; explicit C0 bound and vanishing positivity correction. No rough-current/Hermitian smoothing, fixed-class positive approximation, full external regularization or original closure.

direct_obligations.name: Setting
direct_obligations.check: Compact Kahler manifold, all1≤p≤n, continuous real positive form with distributional ddc zero.

direct_obligations.name: Heat input
direct_obligations.check: Classical real Hodge heat construction smooths at positive time.

direct_obligations.name: Type
direct_obligations.check: Kahler Delta=2Delta_partial=2Delta_bar preserves bidegree.

direct_obligations.name: Reality
direct_obligations.check: Real Hodge Laplacian and its heat operators preserve real forms.

direct_obligations.name: Dolbeault commutation
direct_obligations.check: Each Dolbeault Laplacian commutes with its differential; the two Kahler equalities give commutation with both.

direct_obligations.name: Current equation
direct_obligations.check: Commutation extends by duality to distributions and preserves ddcR0.

direct_obligations.name: Curvature bound
direct_obligations.check: Weitzenbock curvature endomorphism is bounded on the compact manifold and fixed degree.

direct_obligations.name: Gradient sign
direct_obligations.check: The scalar heat equation for norm squared has a nonpositive squared-gradient term.

direct_obligations.name: Maximum estimate
direct_obligations.check: Curvature lower bound and maximum principle give squared-norm exp(2Ct), hence norm exp(Ct).

direct_obligations.name: Smooth initial continuity
direct_obligations.check: The retained classical heat construction tends uniformly to smooth initial forms.

direct_obligations.name: C0 extension
direct_obligations.check: Smooth density and the uniform operator bound give uniform convergence for continuous coefficients.

direct_obligations.name: Error
direct_obligations.check: epsilon_t=uniform norm of H_tR−R tends to zero.

direct_obligations.name: Cone estimate
direct_obligations.check: omega^p evaluates positively and uniformly on unit decomposable p-vectors; finite-dimensional norm control bounds any negative perturbation.

direct_obligations.name: Positivity correction
direct_obligations.check: H_tR+c epsilon_t omega^p equals R plus a nonnegative perturbation.

direct_obligations.name: No heat positivity assumption
direct_obligations.check: Only the corrected form is declared positive.

direct_obligations.name: Correction smoothness
direct_obligations.check: epsilon_t is a scalar depending on time; omega is smooth.

direct_obligations.name: Correction equation
direct_obligations.check: Kahler closedness gives ddc omega^p0.

direct_obligations.name: Uniform limit
direct_obligations.check: Vanishing correction plus heat strong continuity gives uniform R_t→R.

direct_obligations.name: Exterior commutation
direct_obligations.check: Hodge heat commutes with d on all degrees.

direct_obligations.name: Closed branch
direct_obligations.check: IfdR0 both the heat term and correction are closed.

direct_obligations.name: Zero input
direct_obligations.check: R0 yields epsilon0 and zero smooth approximants.

direct_obligations.name: Trace consequence
direct_obligations.check: Uniform coefficient convergence on compact X yields convergence against the fixed smooth omega power.

direct_obligations.name: Class qualification
direct_obligations.check: The positive correction may change the class; no fixed-class theorem is claimed.

direct_obligations.name: Coefficient qualification
direct_obligations.check: No vanishing-error smoothing of arbitrary rough positive currents is inferred.

direct_obligations.name: Exploratory boundary
direct_obligations.check: Kernel iteration and Hermitian continuous-potential product remain unwritten/uncertified and outside this proof.

direct_obligations.name: Original scope
direct_obligations.check: No original problem closure, full regularization/transform/Siu adoption or movable-density certification.
